verdict.rationale: Debugging a live web app is a fair capability to ask of a coding agent, so the axis applies, but no evidence shows OpenCode attaching to, inspecting, or debugging a running web application. MCP support only lets users plug in external tools, which is a building block rather than this capability. The "share links… to debug" item concerns sharing agent sessions, not debugging an app.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug a live running web application directly from my coding assistant
